text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—"I feel like we've met before." It's a 
cliché pickup line, but I truly felt 
destiny at work.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I speak of the steadfast, jet-black 
warrior. My beloved, formidable rival. My 
fated warrior. Just exchanging words stirs 
a vivid, undeniable impulse.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This warrior is my fated chain. We shall 
meet again on the battlefield—undoubtedly 
many times over.
